test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Anya __was a empath__ and had accurate intuitions regarding other people's feelings.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence incorrectly uses "a empath" which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct indefinite article before a word starting with a vowel sound like "empath" is "an".
 
• The correct phrase should be "was an empath", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Anya was an empath and had accurate intuitions regarding other people's feelings."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "being a empath"** – This option is grammatically incorrect because "a" should be "an".
 
• **Option 2: "is an empath"** – This option changes the tense and meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "had an empath"** – This option changes the meaning of the sentence.
